verdict.rationale: The axis applies: TWC collects employer and claimant data through its online services, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data can be kept out of AI model training. Nothing in the pack addresses this. The docs cover tax registration, wage reporting and agency services, and the probes concern machine-readable access (llms.txt, OpenAPI, robots.txt), not how user data is used. No AI-training opt-out, policy statement or data-use control is evidenced.
